# Test fixture policy

These payloads are manually constructed synthetic test data. They do not come
from an Apple Health export or any person's health records.

- Dates use a fixed year-2000 test timeline.
- Names and identifiers explicitly use `Fixture`, `Test`, or reserved example
  values.
- Route coordinates and altitude use the neutral value `0.0`.
- Real exports, names, device identifiers, and location data must never be
  copied into this directory.
